- S&P 500: {{ $json.sp500 }} ({{ $json.sp500Change }})
- Dow Jones: {{ $json.dowJones }} ({{ $json.dowJonesChange }})
- VIX: {{ $json.vix }} ({{ $json.vixChange }})
- Gold: {{ $json.gold }} ({{ $json.goldChange }})
- Oil (WTI): {{ $json.oil }} ({{ $json.oilChange }})
- US Dollar (DXY): {{ $json.dxy }} ({{ $json.dxyChange }})
- Bitcoin: {{ $json.btc }} ({{ $json.btcChange }})

Economic Indicators (USA):
- GDP ({{ $json.gdpYear }}): {{ $json.gdpValue }}
- Inflation/CPI ({{ $json.cpiYear }}): {{ $json.cpiValue }}
- Unemployment ({{ $json.unemploymentYear }}): {{ $json.unemploymentValue }}
- Fed Funds Rate: {{ $json.fedRateValue }}
- 10Y Treasury: {{ $json.treasury10Y }}
- 2Y Treasury: {{ $json.treasury2Y }}

Today's Headlines - cite as headline_1 through headline_{{ $json.headlinesCount }}, one per line below:
{{ $json.headlines }}

Watchlist Performance:
{{ $json.watchlistSummary }}

== YOUR PREVIOUS ANALYSIS (continuity prior) ==
{{ $json.previousAnalysis }}

In your interpretation, briefly address what changed versus your previous analysis (still NO numbers). If your sentiment shifted, one claim should explain why.

== REQUIRED OUTPUT: STRICT JSON ONLY ==
Return ONLY one valid JSON object. No markdown, no code fences, no text before or after it.

Schema (single braces, exactly these fields):
{
  "sentiment": "Bullish" or "Cautiously Bullish" or "Neutral" or "Cautiously Bearish" or "Bearish",
  "confidence": "High" or "Medium" or "Low",
  "claims": [
    { "claim": "one factual market observation in plain words with NO numbers",
      "basedOn": ["factKey", "factKey"],
      "direction": "supports_bullish" or "supports_bearish" or "neutral" }
  ],
  "interpretation": "2-3 sentences of qualitative synthesis for a value investor. NO numbers.",
  "wisdom": "one Buffett or Graham principle applied to today's conditions. NO numbers."
}

buffettIndicator, shillerPE, yieldCurve, sp500VsMa200, maSignal, fearGreedValue, sp500, sp500Change, dowJones, dowJonesChange, vix, vixChange, gold, goldChange, oil, oilChange, dxy, dxyChange, btc, btcChange, gdpValue, cpiValue, unemploymentValue, fedRateValue, treasury10Y, treasury2Y, headline_1 through headline_{{ $json.headlinesCount }} (there are {{ $json.headlinesCount }} headlines listed above today), plus today's watchlist stock keys: {{ $json.watchlistFactKeys }}

1. NEVER write digits or numeric values anywhere in claim, interpretation, or wisdom text. The delivery system injects the exact numbers from source data using your basedOn keys. Any digit you write is a rule violation and your analysis will be withheld.

6. A headline_N citation is verified only for EXISTENCE (that headline N was genuinely in today's fetch) - not for whether your claim accurately reflects its content. So when citing a headline, describe only what its title plainly states, never infer or embellish beyond it.

Use the exact sentiment and confidence enum strings specified above.
Provide two to four claims. Each claim must contain only claim, basedOn, and direction.
Every basedOn array must contain unique, available fact keys, with no more than twelve entries.
Never cite missing, malformed, N/A, or unavailable readings. A headline citation only establishes that its title was fetched; it does not establish the truth of an interpretation.
Use concise qualitative English in claim, interpretation, and wisdom. Do not write digits, number words, ordinal words, fractions, percentage words, or numeric instrument names in these fields. The filter conservatively rejects words such as one, first, half, quarter, million, and percent even when used idiomatically. Say broad equities instead of a numeric index name. Exact fact keys in basedOn may contain digits.
Keep claims within six hundred characters each, interpretation within twelve hundred, and wisdom within six hundred. Prefer much shorter wording so every claim can be displayed beside its evidence.
